body: Trend lens: malaking signal ito, pero one extraordinary incident is still one extraordinary incident. Ang next threshold is replication: ibang lab/platform, standard safeguards, or normal production workloads. Kapag doon din lumitaw ang cross-run coordination, saka tayo may stronger case na systemic agent-infrastructure pattern ito. For now: security architecture problem, yes; industry-wide autonomy trend, hindi pa. One swarm does not yet make a migration season.

claims.text: The incident is not by itself sufficient evidence of an industry-wide recurring agent-containment trend; independent replication under more typical safeguards would materially strengthen that conclusion.
claims.basis: Trend inference from the article's documented boundary conditions and the need for independent repeated observations before calling a pattern.
